## Load packages & source functions

```{r load libraries}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(tidylog)
library(RCurl)
library(devtools)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(patchwork)
library(concaveman)
library(ggtext)

# Set path
home <- here::here()

# Source code for map plots
source(paste0(home, "/R/functions/map-plot.R"))
options(ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis")
```

## Load data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

d <- read_csv(paste0(home, "/output/trends_long.csv"))
```

## Plot environmental variables!

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pal <- brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdYlBu")

pp <- plot_map + 
  #guides(fill = guide_colorbar(legend.position = "inside")) +
  theme_sleek(base_size = 8) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.25, 0.8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.25, "line"),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "line"),
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0), "cm"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 7))

# Because they are on different scales, I'll build the plot using patchwork instead of e.g. pivot longer
# Temperature
p1 <- pp + 
  geom_raster(data = d, aes(X*1000, Y*1000, fill = mean_temp), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "magma", name = "°C") +
  geom_sf(color = "gray30") +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  annotate("text", label = "SE", x = xmin2 + 0.3*xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.6*yrange, color = "gray30", size = 2) +
  annotate("text", label = "DK", x = xmin2 + 0.012*xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.32*yrange, color = "gray30", size = 2) +
  annotate("text", label = "DE", x = xmin2 + 0.07*xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.02*yrange, color = "gray30", size = 2) +
  annotate("text", label = "PL", x = xmin2 + 0.58*xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.02*yrange, color = "gray30", size = 2) +
  annotate("text", label = "RU", x = xmin2 + 0.95*xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.18*yrange, color = "gray30", size = 2) +
  annotate("text", label = "LT", x = xmin2 + 1*xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.43*yrange, color = "gray30", size = 2) +
  annotate("text", label = "LV", x = xmin2 + 0.99*xrange, y = ymin2 + 0.65*yrange, color = "gray30", size = 2) +
  annotate("text", label = "(a)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.9, color = "gray40", size = 3)

# Salinity
p2 <- pp + 
  geom_raster(data = d, aes(X*1000, Y*1000, fill = mean_sal), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "cividis", name = "psu") +
  geom_sf(color = "gray30") +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  annotate("text", label = "(b)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.9, color = "gray40", size = 3)


# Oxygen
p3 <- pp + 
  geom_raster(data = d, aes(X*1000, Y*1000, fill = mean_oxy), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "mako", 
                     name = expression(paste("O"[2], " (ml/L)"))) +
  geom_sf(color = "gray30") +
  annotate("text", label = "(c)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.9, color = "gray40", size = 3) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

## Trends
p4 <- pp + 
  geom_raster(data = d, aes(X*1000, Y*1000, fill = temp_slope), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(name = "°C/decade", high = pal[11], low = pal[1],
                       breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) + 
  geom_sf(color = "gray30") +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
  annotate("text", label = "(d)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.9, color = "gray40", size = 3)

p5 <- pp + 
  geom_raster(data = d, aes(X*1000, Y*1000, fill = sal_slope), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(name = "psu/decade", high = pal[11], low = pal[1],
                       breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) + 
  geom_sf(color = "gray30") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  annotate("text", label = "(e)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.9, color = "gray40", size = 3)

p6 <- pp + 
  geom_raster(data = d, aes(X*1000, Y*1000, fill = oxy_slope), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(name = expression(paste("O"[2], "/decade")), high = pal[11], low = pal[1],
                       breaks = c(-1, -0.5, 0)) +
  geom_sf(color = "gray30") +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  annotate("text", label = "(f)", x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.9, color = "gray40", size = 3)

((p1 + p2 + p3) / (p4 + p5 + p6)) + plot_layout(axes = "collect") &
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 9))

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/supp/env_vars_space.pdf"), width = 18, height = 11, units = "cm")
```

## Now do biotic variables... add here the boundary!

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Read the biotic trends and velocities
trend <- d |>
  filter(cumulative == "Y") |> 
  mutate(id = paste(X, Y, group, sep = "_"))

# Read the prediction grid and join all grid cells so that I can color the filtered cells as NA
full_grid <- crossing(d |> dplyr::select(X, Y),
                      group = unique(trend$group)) |>
  mutate(id = paste(X, Y, group, sep = "_"))

full_grid_trends <- full_grid |>
  filter(!id %in% unique(trend$id)) |> 
  mutate(mean_biom = NA, 
         biom_trend = NA)

trend <- bind_rows(trend, full_grid_trends)

# Because we trim the grids, let's add a polygon that is the overall outside border.
border_df <- trend
z <- concaveman(cbind(border_df$X, border_df$Y), concavity = 1)
#plot(z)
z_poly <- sp::SpatialPolygons(list(sp::Polygons(list(sp::Polygon(z)), ID = 1)))
domain <- as.data.frame(z_poly@polygons[[1]]@Polygons[[1]]@coords)
colnames(domain) <- c("X", "Y")

trend <- trend |>
  separate_wider_delim(group, delim = "_", names = c("species", "life_stage"), cols_remove = FALSE) |>
  mutate(life_stage = str_to_sentence(life_stage),
         species = str_to_sentence(species)) |>
  mutate(group2 = paste(species, life_stage),
         group2 = factor(group2,
                         levels = c("Cod Adult", "Cod Juvenile", "Flounder Adult", "Flounder Juvenile",
                                    "Plaice Adult", "Plaice Juvenile", "Turbot All", "Whiting All", "Dab All")))

plot_map_fc + 
  geom_raster(data = trend, aes(X*1000, Y*1000, fill = biom_trend), alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(na.value="grey94", trans = "log10", midpoint = 0,
                        low = pal[1], high = pal[11]) +
  facet_grid(life_stage~species) +
  #facet_wrap(~group) +
  geom_sf(color = "gray30") +
  geom_path(data = domain, aes(X*1000, Y*1000), color = "red", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = 2) + 
  labs(fill = "Multiplicative change in biomass density per decade") +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.key.width = unit(1.1, "cm"),
        legend.title.position = "top")

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/spatial_trends.pdf"), width = 18, height = 12, units = "cm")
```
